report:
Debezium JDBC sink connector in AWS MSK connect to Postgres

I have successfully setup a AWS MSK source connector from Oracle to Kafka - Now I'm trying to setup a sink connector version 3.7.x from Kafka to Postgres (RDS in AWS). I am using Debezium JDBC sink connector version 3.1.1.Final.
When the connector starts up, it throws this error in the logs. I've searched this forum as well as other google searches and I have been unsuccessful. Any help or pointers on where I would go next would be appreciated.

evidence.quote: Your Kafka Connect `/lib` directory has an older Jackson version on the global class path than what Hibernate is compatible with." Reporter got past it by adding Jackson jars.

notes: NoClassDefFoundError in Hibernate init reads like a packaging bug; the cause is a Jackson version conflict in the MSK Connect runtime classpath.

reviews.fix: Add compatible Jackson 2.16.x jars to the JDBC sink plugin directory because the Connect runtime classpath had an incompatible older Jackson.
reviews.evidence: Chris Cranford: "Your Kafka Connect /lib directory has an older Jackson version on the global class path than what Hibernate is compatible with." / Ramesh: "I was able to get past the error by adding the following jars."
reviews.boundary: A vs C: the runtime classpath (MSK Connect plugin/lib) is deployed and configured by the operator, who made the fix -> C.
